headline: In a West Bank cave, Israelis and Palestinians hold an out-of-the-ordinary lunch
context: In the occupied West Bank, Israeli settlers keep seizing land in areas where Palestinians have lived for generations. The conflict even reaches caves in remote corners of the territory.

sources.name: NPR
